about: The lowest versions a box may run. packages/protocol/src/boxArtifact.ts holds the same Node number (NODE_SECURITY_FLOOR); a test fails if they differ. Raise it when an upstream security release lands; never lower it.

node.why: Node 20 is end of life (2026-03-24). 24.22.1 and 22.23.4 update the built-in root certificates and reject chains with blocked public keys.
